brief.audience: External visitors looking for clear, approachable ways to volunteer.
brief.job: Search fictional opportunities by activity, place, organization, and focus area.
brief.principalDoubt: Whether the opportunity expectations and organizations are clear enough to choose where to help.
brief.proof: Eight complete fictional opportunities, three fictional organizations, visible time and place requirements, and explicit sample-content labels.
brief.thesis: Optimistic civic energy expressed through warm paper, bold green actions, colorful community categories, and a simple shared-path illustration.
brief.signatureMoment: The arched hero illustration turns two abstract people and a shared green path into the phrase Together starts here.

categories.name: First impression and clarity
categories.evidence: Home desktop/mobile names the public volunteer-directory purpose, presents Explore opportunities as the sole primary action, and immediately shows sample counts and fictional-content context.

categories.name: Attention and hierarchy
categories.evidence: The oversized civic headline and arched Together starts here illustration create one coordinated focal point, followed by a clear promise band, finder, results, and closing panel at both widths.

categories.name: Cognitive fluency and usability
categories.evidence: The catalog uses one search field, one focus-area selector, live result count, stable card anatomy, visible empty state, and direct time/place labels.

categories.name: Narrative and page flow
categories.evidence: The single page moves from motivation to proof, expectations, discovery controls, complete opportunities, and a practical customization handoff.

categories.name: Copy and value communication
categories.evidence: Headlines, opportunity summaries, commitment labels, locations, organization names, search guidance, and fictional-content boundaries are concrete and consistent.

categories.name: Trust and proof
categories.evidence: The hero, proof counters, promise band, cards, closing panel, and footer clearly distinguish fictional sample content while showing complete expectations for eight opportunities.

categories.name: Brand and visual coherence
categories.evidence: Warm paper, forest green, civic blue/coral/gold, Georgia display type, Segoe UI body type, organization medallions, rounded cards, and the shared-path motif form one coherent system.

categories.name: Responsive and accessible design
categories.evidence: Desktop/mobile evidence preserves hierarchy and card readability; two declared axe scans pass at score 100 with zero violations and zero incomplete checks, with focus and reduced-motion handling present.

categories.name: Interaction and motion craft
categories.evidence: Search/filter/result/empty states are functional; buttons and cards have focus, hover, pressed, and reduced-motion behavior without delaying reading.

categories.name: Detail and memorable finish
categories.evidence: The arched hero, geometric people, proof rules, category ribbons, compact metadata, closing panel, and footer-integrated attribution remain aligned and overlap-free at both widths.

criticalGates.name: Clear offering and primary CTA
criticalGates.evidence: The first screen identifies a volunteer opportunity directory and makes Explore opportunities the single primary action.

criticalGates.name: Single first-impression focal point
criticalGates.evidence: The headline and adjacent illustration operate as one hero composition; supporting copy, action, and counters are subordinate.

criticalGates.name: Accessible primary flow
criticalGates.evidence: Desktop/mobile axe scans pass with zero violations and incomplete checks; search, select, links, focus indicators, contrast, and live result changes are accessible.

criticalGates.name: Honest proof and representation
criticalGates.evidence: Organizations, opportunities, and counts are repeatedly identified as fictional sample content and do not imply a live program.

criticalGates.name: Working mobile layout
criticalGates.evidence: The mobile capture shows no overlap, clipping, horizontal overflow, or inaccessible primary action across hero, filters, eight cards, closing panel, and footer.

criticalGates.name: Verified font loading
criticalGates.evidence: The design uses installed system font stacks with declared weights and no synthetic or remote-font dependency.

criticalGates.name: Specific and coherent visual identity
criticalGates.evidence: The civic palette, path illustration, organization marks, opportunity ribbons, and optimistic copy make the page specific to community volunteering.
